statements.name: thm:main
statements.text:
\label{thm:main}
For every integer \(d\ge3\), there is a constant \(c_d>0\) such that
every finite set \(P\subset\mathbb R^d\) of \(n\ge2\) distinct points
satisfies
\[
 |\Delta(P)|\ge c_d n^{2/d}.
\]
